sections.summary_en: The daily agenda for the Federal Parliament of Nepal's Joint Meeting, Meeting Number 1, scheduled for Monday, Baishakh 28, 2083, at 4:00 PM, was presented. The main item on the agenda is an address by the Right Honourable President.
